title: Writes that bypass Django mutations (no events/activity log)
answers: Why didn't an issue change emit a lifecycle event?
body:
Paths that skip activity log and/or lifecycle events:
- bulk_update_issues status uses QuerySet.update() (skips save()); passes opener_allowed=False to lifecycle events.
- Temporal auto-merge: EB/temporal/fingerprint_embedding_result/activities.py:_merge_fingerprint_into_closest_issue (gated by ERROR_TRACKING_AUTO_MERGE_ENABLED) writes no activity log, emits no event.
- Cymbal (rust/cymbal/src/modes/processing/issue_resolution.rs) inserts and reopens issues directly in Postgres.
- Also EB/logic/github_external_references.py and management command backfill_error_tracking_issue_legacy_statuses.
- ClickHouse sync: sync_issues_to_clickhouse version is ms timestamp, must match cymbal FingerprintIssueState::new.
applies: When adding logic that must react to every issue change; user API paths through issue_mutations.py are covered, these are not.
says: Issue status changed but activity log shows no record
Automatic issue merges happen silently with no audit trail
Activity history missing entries for background job issue updates
Who reassigned or resolved this issue - no changelog entry
External system updates to issues don't appear in timeline
search: Several code paths skip activity log and lifecycle events when writing to the database, including QuerySet.update() for bulk_update_issues status, temporal auto-merge in fingerprint_embedding_result/activities.py:_merge_fingerprint_into_closest_issue (gated by ERROR_TRACKING_AUTO_MERGE_ENABLED), Cymbal (rust/cymbal/src/modes/processing/issue_resolution.rs) directly inserting/reopening in Postgres, github_external_references.py, and the backfill_error_tracking_issue_legacy_statuses management command. ClickHouse sync (sync_issues_to_clickhouse) uses ms timestamp version that must match cymbal FingerprintIssueState::new. When adding logic that must react to every issue change, be aware that these paths are not covered by events—user API paths through issue_mutations.py are covered, but direct database writes and temporal automations are not. Applies to error tracking backend logic that depends on complete issue change tracking.
